AcademicReviewRequest.name: AcademicReviewRequest
AcademicReviewRequest.description: Represents the details of the review request for an academic curriculum.

AgeInDays.description: The age in days for which the request is pending.

ApprovalRequestedForId.description: The record for which the review request was raised.

Description.description: The description of the review request.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

OwnerId.description: The user who owns this record.

Status.description: Specifies the status of the review by faculty.
